scope: This computer as Host + Coordinator through the production setup controller (src/local-host.ts), the App's native Layout code (src-tauri/src/local_host.rs via examples/local-host-helper.rs) and the bundled envd sidecar, installed as a real launchd LaunchAgent on macOS.
reproduce: FM_LOCALNET_RPC=http://127.0.0.1:39000 FM_LOCALNET_FAUCET=http://127.0.0.1:39123 node --import tsx scripts/product-deployment-localnet.ts <isolated contracts copy>/protocol <deployment.json>

checks: fresh profile: not configured, service not installed, free loopback port suggested
one call: keys → device binding → config → funded invite → Host join over stdin → service, no invitation outside memory/stdin
chain: binding to this Host's key on loopback, invitation consumed, membership active
the Host was funded in the invite PTB and paid its own join Gas
launchd LaunchAgent installed with RunAtLoad/KeepAlive and running
device-authenticated Coordinator read shows this Host online with a verified signed observation
stop disables and frees the port; start re-enables and listens again
re-running setup signs and broadcasts nothing new
revoke: membership revoked on chain, service removed, configuration removed
Host key removed from the credential store
